nodes.label: Use the discriminant

nodes.label: Roots and coefficients

nodes.label: Factorise over complex numbers

nodes.label: Form equations; signs of roots

nodes.label: Remainder Theorem, linear divisors

nodes.label: Synthetic division

nodes.label: Factorise using Factor Theorem

nodes.label: Solve higher-degree equations

nodes.label: Determine cubic coefficients

nodes.label: Simplify expressions with ω

questions.stem: A sound engineer is programming a stereo echo plugin where complex numbers track the volume and timing of audio waves. To perfectly center the sound between the left speaker (volume multiplier x) and right speaker (volume multiplier y), the two audio paths must balance according to this equation: $(1+2i)(x+i)=x(y+i)$. Find the exact values of the real numbers x and y.
solution: Expand the left side: (1+2i)(x+i) = x + i + 2xi + 2i².
Expand the right side: x(y+i) = xy + xi.
Equate imaginary parts: 1 + 2x = x, so x = -1.
Put x = -1 in x - 2 = xy: -3 = -y, so y = 3.
